adds isStubDataMode(), which the four data seams below call: stub data in production too, where the prototype has no backend, address book or reference data. Also changes isStubMode() itself to honour STUB_MODE in production, by design (Sam's decision): the deployed prototype signs in exactly like a local `npm run dev` — stub sign-in, open to anyone who reaches it unless PROTOTYPE_PASSWORD puts the prototype's own shared password in front (src/server/prototype-password) — unless STUB_MODE=false restores plants-frontend's own Defra ID sign-in.
